The '''Hallowed Sepulchre''' is an [[Agility]] activity set in an ancient [[Saradomin]]ist burial ground of the city [[Hallowvale]], located beneath [[Darkmeyer]] available to players with level 52 [[Agility]] and completion of [[Sins of the Father]]. There are five floors available scaling with the player's Agility level. In order to receive [[hallowed marks]], the [[Coffin (Hallowed Sepulchre)|coffins]] must be looted, with deeper floors providing more marks per looted coffin. [[Noticeboard (Hallowed Sepulchre)|Noticeboards]] are located next to the stairs on either side of the lobby, where players can check their personal statistics within the Sepulchre, as well as the global statistics.
